Method of Attack: Malicious macros in Excel spreadsheet execute to download and install Koadic penetration test and post-exploitation toolkit
Gains complete control over infected computer to execute commands such as downloading further malware or stealing files
Impacted Systems: Infected computer (implied Windows due to Excel macros and Koadic usage)
Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious Excel attachment named TestResults.xlsb
Indicators of Compromise: Emails pretending to be HIV test results from 'Vanderbit University' (misspelled)
